defs.d: A sequence of rhythmic steps or movements usually performed to music, for pleasure or as a form of social interaction.
A social gathering where dancing is the main activity.
To move with rhythmic steps or movements, especially in time to music.
defs.ex: I danced with her all night long.

defs.d: To leap or move lightly and rapidly.
defs.ex: His eyes danced with pleasure as he spoke.   She accused her political opponent of dancing around the issue instead of confronting it.

defs.d: Moving around; astir.
defs.ex: After my bout with Guillan-Barre Syndrome, it took me 6 months to be up and about again.

defs.d: In existence; being in evidence; apparent.
defs.ex: This idea has been about for a while but has only recently become fashionable.

defs.d: On all sides; around.
defs.ex: I looked about at the scenery that surrounded me.

defs.d: Here and there; around; in one place and another; up and down.
defs.ex: Bits of old machinery were lying about.

defs.d: In a circle around; all round; on every side of; on the outside of.
defs.ex: The snake was coiled about his ankle.

defs.d: Over or upon different parts of; through or over in various directions; here and there in; to and fro in; throughout.
defs.ex: He was well known about town.

defs.d: A vehicle that has two wheels, one behind the other, a steering handle, and a saddle seat or seats and is usually propelled by the action of a rider’s feet upon pedals.
A traveling block used on a cable in skidding logs.
To travel or exercise using a bicycle.
A vehicle that has two wheels, one behind the other, a steering handle, and a saddle seat or seats and is usually propelled by the action of a rider’s feet upon pedals.
A traveling block used on a cable in skidding logs.
To ride a bike.
defs.ex: I biked so much yesterday that I'm very sore today.

defs.d: To travel by bike.
defs.ex: It was such a nice day I decided to bike to the store, though it's far enough I usually take my car.

defs.d: A motorcycle.
A small and light motorcycle.
A corporate group; a group of colleagues.
(in some proper nouns) A group sharing common purposes or goals.
defs.ex: College of Cardinals, College of Surgeons

defs.d: A flying insect, of the clade Anthophila within the hymenopteran superfamily Apoidea, known for its organised societies (though only a minority have them), for collecting pollen and (in some species) producing wax and honey.
A contest, especially for spelling; see spelling bee.
defs.ex: geography bee

defs.d: A community gathering to share labour, e.g. a sewing bee or a quilting bee.
A ring or torque; a bracelet.
The time ahead; those moments yet to be experienced.
Something that will happen in moments yet to come.
Having to do with or occurring in the future.
defs.ex: Future generations will either laugh or cry at our stupidity.

defs.d: Short for futures contract.
A mother of someone's parent.
A female ancestor or progenitor.
To repeat (an activity) as a way of improving one's skill in that activity.
defs.ex: You should practise playing piano every day.

defs.d: To repeat an activity in this way.
defs.ex: If you want to speak French well, you need to practise.

defs.d: Any of a range of colours having the longest wavelengths, 670 nm, of the visible spectrum; a primary additive colour for transmitted light: the colour obtained by subtracting green and blue from white light using magenta and yellow filters; the colour of blood, ripe strawberries, etc.
A revolutionary socialist or (most commonly) a Communist; (usually capitalized) a Bolshevik, a supporter of the Bolsheviks in the Russian Civil War.
Having red as its color.
defs.ex: The girl wore a red skirt.

defs.d: (of hair) Having an orange-brown or orange-blond colour; ginger.
defs.ex: Her hair had red highlights.

defs.d: A paintbrush.
A writing utensil with a graphite (commonly referred to as lead) shaft, usually blended with clay, clad in wood, and sharpened to a taper.
To write (something) using a pencil.
defs.ex: I penciled (BrE: pencilled) a brief reminder in my notebook.

defs.d: To mark with, or as if with, a pencil.
(in negative or interrogative constructions) From a given time onwards; longer, again.
defs.ex: They don't make repairable radios any more.

defs.d: (in positive constructions) Now, from now on.
defs.ex: I eat fish anymore.

defs.d: Grief, sorrow.
Close attention; concern; responsibility.
defs.ex: Care should be taken when holding babies.

defs.d: The arithmetic mean.
defs.ex: The average of 10, 20 and 24 is (10 + 20 + 24)/3 = 18.

defs.d: Any measure of central tendency, especially any mean, the median, or the mode.
To compute the average of, especially the arithmetic mean.
defs.ex: If you average 10, 20 and 24, you get 18.

defs.d: Over a period of time or across members of a population, to have or generate a mean value of.
defs.ex: I averaged 75% in my examinations this year.

defs.d: Constituting or relating to the average.
defs.ex: The average age of the participants was 18.5.

defs.d: Neither very good nor very bad; rated somewhere in the middle of all others in the same category.
defs.ex: I soon found I was only an average chess player.

defs.d: A short symbol, often with little relation to the item it represents.
defs.ex: This flavour of soup has been assigned the code WRT-9.

defs.d: A body of law, sanctioned by legislation, in which the rules of law to be specifically applied by the courts are set forth in systematic form; a compilation of laws by public authority; a digest.
To write software programs.
defs.ex: I learned to code on an early home computer in the 1980s.

defs.d: To add codes to a dataset.
Deviation of the path of a rolling ball from a straight line; slope; slant.

defs.d: A borrow pit.
To receive (something) from somebody temporarily, expecting to return it.
To take money from a bank under the agreement that the bank will be paid over the course of time.
The place in which something happens.

defs.d: Interrogative adverb, used in either a direct or indirect question: at what place; to what place; what place.
defs.ex: He asked where I grew up.

defs.d: In what situation.
defs.ex: Where would we be without our parents?

defs.d: The place in which.
defs.ex: He lives within five miles of where he was born.

defs.d: Reliance on the truth of something said or done; faith; trust.
Recognition and respect.
defs.ex: He arrived five minutes late, but to his credit he did work an extra ten minutes at the end of his shift.

defs.d: To believe; to put credence in.
defs.ex: Someone said there were over 100,000 people there, but I can't credit that.

defs.d: To add to an account.
defs.ex: Credit accounts receivable with the amount of the invoice.

defs.d: Matter in a state intermediate between liquid and plasma that can be contained only if it is fully surrounded by a solid (or in a bubble of liquid) (or held together by gravitational pull); it can condense into a liquid, or can (rarely) become a solid directly.
defs.ex: A lot of gas had escaped from the cylinder.

defs.d: A chemical element or compound in such a state.
defs.ex: The atmosphere is made up of a number of different gases.

defs.d: To kill with poisonous gas.
To talk in a boastful or vapid way; chatter.
To manage, control, steer.
defs.ex: to direct the affairs of a nation or the movements of an army

defs.d: To aim (something) at (something else).
defs.ex: He directed his question to the room in general.

defs.d: Proceeding without deviation or interruption.
Straight; not crooked, oblique, or circuitous; leading by the short or shortest way to a point or end.
defs.ex: the most direct route between two buildings

defs.d: Directly.
Twice the number, amount, size, etc.
A person who resembles and stands in for another person, often for safety purposes
defs.ex: Saddam Hussein was rumored to have many doubles.

defs.d: To multiply by two.
defs.ex: The company doubled their earnings per share over last quarter.

defs.d: To fold over so as to make two folds.
defs.ex: To make a pleat, double the material at the waist.

defs.d: Made up of two matching or complementary elements.
defs.ex: The closet has double doors.

defs.d: Of twice the quantity.
defs.ex: Give me a double serving of mashed potatoes.

defs.d: A yellowish citrus fruit.
A semitropical evergreen tree, Citrus limon, that bears such fruits.
To flavour with lemon.
defs.ex: You can start the vegetables cooking while you are lemoning the fish.

defs.d: Containing or having the flavour/flavor and/or scent of lemons.
Of the pale yellow colour/color of lemons.
A smooth surface, usually made of glass with reflective material painted on the underside, that reflects light so as to give an image of what is in front of it.
defs.ex: I had a look in the mirror to see if the blood had come off my face.

defs.d: An object, person, or event that reflects or gives a picture of another.
defs.ex: His story is a mirror into the life of orphans growing up.

defs.d: Of an event, activity, behaviour, etc, to be identical to, to be a copy of.
To create something identical to (a web site, etc.).
(obsolete outside dialectal) An assize.
A regulation determining the amount of money paid in fees, taxes etc.
To adjust the size of; to make a certain size.
To classify or arrange by size.
A response.
A versicle or short anthem chanted at intervals during the reading of a lection.
To say something in return; to answer; to reply.
defs.ex: to respond to a question or an argument

defs.d: To act in return; to carry out an action or in return to a force or stimulus; to do something in response.
A festive gathering to foster introductions.
defs.ex: They organized a social at the dance club to get people to know each other.

defs.d: A dance held to raise money for a couple to be married.
Being extroverted or outgoing.
defs.ex: James is a very social guy; he knows lots of people.

defs.d: Of or relating to society.
defs.ex: Teresa feels uncomfortable in certain social situations.

defs.d: Interactive forms of media that allow users to interact with and publish to each other, generally by means of the Internet.
defs.ex: The early 21st century saw a huge increase in social media thanks to the widespread availability of the Internet.

defs.d: To draw air into (inhale), and expel air from (exhale), the lungs in order to extract oxygen and excrete waste gases.
To take in needed gases and expel waste gases in a similar way.
defs.ex: Fish have gills so they can breathe underwater.

defs.d: (physical) Visual perception.
A picture, drawn or painted; a sketch.
defs.ex: a fine view of Lake George

defs.d: To look at.
defs.ex: The video was viewed by millions of people.

defs.d: To regard in a stated way.
defs.ex: I view it as a serious breach of trust.

defs.d: A desire, hope, or longing for something or for something to happen.
An expression of such a desire, often connected with ideas of magic and supernatural power.
To desire; to want.
defs.ex: I'll come tomorrow, if you wish it.

defs.d: To hope (+ object clause with may or in present subjunctive).
Something from which other things extend; a foundation.
The starting point of a logical deduction or thought; basis.
To give as its foundation or starting point; to lay the foundation of.
To be located (at a particular place).
A low spectrum of sound tones.

defs.d: A section of musical group that produces low-pitched sound, lower than the baritone and tenor.
defs.ex: The conductor preferred to situate the bass in the middle rear, rather than to one side of the orchestra.

defs.d: A man of gentle but not noble birth, particularly a man of means (originally ownership of property) who does not work for a living but has no official status in a peerage; an armiferous man ranking below a knight.
defs.ex: Being a gentleman, Robert was entitled to shove other commoners into the gongpit but he still had to jump out of the way of the knights to avoid the same fate himself.

defs.d: Any well-bred, well-mannered, or charming man.
A defect or failing; moral or spiritual degeneracy.
A deficiency or need (of something desirable or necessary); an absence, want.
To be without, to need, to require.

defs.d: To be short (of or for something).
defs.ex: He'll never lack for company while he's got all that money.

defs.d: To make a donation; to give away something of value to support or contribute towards a cause or for the benefit of another.
defs.ex: He donated an etching from his own collection to the new art gallery.

defs.d: An instance of throwing and catching each prop at least twice.
To describe or characterize something by listing its qualities.
To make someone, or to become competent or eligible for some position or task.
Capable of being seen, or easily seen; open to view; visible to the eye, eyely; within sight or view.
Clear or manifest to the understanding; plain; evident; obvious; known; palpable; indubitable.
A pavilion or portable lodge consisting of skins, canvas, or some strong cloth, stretched and sustained by poles, used for sheltering people from the weather.
defs.ex: We were camping in a three-man tent.

defs.d: The representation of a tent used as a bearing.
To go camping.

defs.d: To prop up aluminum foil in an inverted "V" (reminiscent of a pop-up tent) over food to reduce splatter, before putting it in the oven.
The amount of money or resources earmarked for a particular institution, activity or time-frame.
An itemized summary of intended expenditure; usually coupled with expected revenue.
To construct or draw up a budget.
defs.ex: Budgeting is even harder in times of recession

defs.d: To provide funds, allow for in a budget.
defs.ex: The PM’s pet projects are budgeted rather generously

defs.d: Of or relating to a budget.
Appropriate to a restricted budget.
defs.ex: We flew on a budget airline.

defs.d: A living being; an animal or (sometimes derogatory) a human.
defs.ex: He's a creature of habit.   insects and other creatures

defs.d: A created thing, whether animate or inanimate; a creation.
Recognition of importance or value; respect; veneration (of someone, usually for being morally upright or successful)
defs.ex: The crowds gave the returning general much honor and praise.

defs.d: The state of being morally upright, honest, noble, virtuous, and magnanimous; excellence of character; the perception of such a state; favourable reputation; dignity
defs.ex: He was a most perfect knight, for he had great honor and chivalry.

defs.d: To think of highly, to respect highly; to show respect for; to recognise the importance or spiritual value of
defs.ex: The freedom fighters will be forever remembered and honored by the people.

defs.d: To conform to, abide by, act in accordance with (an agreement, treaty, promise, request, or the like)
defs.ex: I trusted you, but you have not honored your promise.

defs.d: To make a threat against someone; to use threats.
defs.ex: He threatened me with a knife.

defs.d: To menace, or be dangerous.
defs.ex: The rocks threatened the ship's survival.

defs.d: A person who is held in servitude as the property of another person, and whose labor (and often also whose body and life) is subject to the owner's volition and control.
A drudge; one who labors or is obliged (e.g. by prior contract) to labor like a slave with limited rights, e.g. an indentured servant.
To work as a slaver, to enslave people.
To work hard.
defs.ex: I was slaving all day over a hot stove.
